title: Number of provinces
statementMd:
`is_connected[i][j] == 1` means cities i and j are directly connected (the matrix is symmetric). Return the number of provinces (groups of directly or indirectly connected cities).

**Example:** `find_provinces([[1, 1, 0], [1, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]])` returns `2`.
hints: Union-find or DFS on the matrix.
